Splay tree implementation. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Splay_tree

SplayTree[K; V] = object

Procs

proc `[]`[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): var V
Recover value of key in tree. Splays on access. Raises KeyError if key is not found. Source   Edit   
proc `[]=`[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K; value: V)
Add key and value pair to tree. Source   Edit   
proc contains[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): bool
Returns true if key exists in tree. Source   Edit   
proc find[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]; key: K; value: var V): bool
Recover the value from the key; truthy if value was modified. Does not splay (const tree). Source   Edit   
proc find[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): (V, bool)
Find the value associated with a given key. Returns the value and true if the key was found, and a default value and false if not. Splays the accessed node to the root. Source   Edit   
proc find[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K; value: var V): bool
Recover the value from the key; truthy if value was modified. Splays the accessed node to the root. Source   Edit   
proc insert[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K; value: V): bool {.
    discardable.}
Source   Edit   
proc len[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]): int
Returns the number of items in the tree. Source   Edit   
proc max[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]): (K, V)
Returns the largest key/value pair in the tree. Raises ValueError if the tree is empty. Source   Edit   
proc min[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]): (K, V)
Returns the smallest key/value pair in the tree. Raises ValueError if the tree is empty. Source   Edit   
proc newSplayTree[K, V](): SplayTree[K, V]
Construct a new Splay tree. Source   Edit   
proc peek[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): (V, bool)
Query without splaying. Returns (value, true) if found, (default, false) otherwise. Source   Edit   
proc pop[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): V {.discardable.}
Remove key from tree and return its value. Raises KeyError if key is not found. Source   Edit   
proc popMax[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]): (K, V) {.discardable.}
Removes and returns the largest key/value pair in the tree. Raises ValueError if the tree is empty. Source   Edit   
proc popMin[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]): (K, V) {.discardable.}
Removes and returns the smallest key/value pair in the tree. Raises ValueError if the tree is empty. Source   Edit   
proc rank[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): Natural
Returns the 0-indexed position of key in tree. Raises KeyError if key is not found. Source   Edit   
proc remove[K, V](tree: var SplayTree[K, V]; key: K): bool {.discardable.}
Remove a key value pair from the tree. Returns true if something was removed, false if the key wasn't found, so nothing was removed. Source   Edit   
proc select[K, V](tree: SplayTree[K, V]; i: int): (K, V)
Returns the i'th smallest (0-indexed) item in tree. Negative indices count from the end (-1 = last). Raises IndexDefect if index is out of bounds. Source   Edit
